use_cases: Display playful headings with a dynamic hover effect that removes layered shadows
Add interactive typography to hero sections with colorful multi-shadow styling
Create engaging call-to-action text with an instant 'swoosh away' shadow reveal on hover
Enhance landing page headlines with customizable neon-style shadow effects
Use as decorative section dividers or feature labels with animated text shadows
ai_summary: A typography component featuring multi-layered colorful text shadows that animate away on hover, creating a playful 'swoosh' reveal effect. Built with motion/react and fully customizable shadow colors, making it ideal for creating dynamic, eye-catching headings and decorative text in hero sections, marketing pages, or feature callouts.
